RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the April 30, 2002/Vaisakha 10, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—20
Indira Lift Irrigation Scheme
†*501. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether lift irrigation schemes are
proposed in various States of the country; if
so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(b) whether ‘Indira Lift Scheme’ for lift
irrigation from Chambal in Sawai Madhopur
and Karoli districts in Rajasthan is under
Government’s consideration; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Development of tourist spots in
Rajasthan
†*502. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL: Will the Minister of
TOURISM AND CULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
any plan to increase the number of tourist
spots and develop them further in other
places of Rajasthan in addition to Jaisalmer;
and
(b) if so, the details of places where new
tourist spots are being considered to be set
up?
Civil Aviation Security Training
Academy
*503. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
DR. (MS.) P. SELVIE DAS:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to setup a Hi-tech Civil Aviation
Security Training Academy;
(b) if so, the estimated cost of the project;
and
(c) what are the locational and technical
details of the project?
FDI in tea plantation sector
*504. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRI V. V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned
"Government may allow FDI in tea
plantations" which appeared in the Business
Standard dated the 5th April, 2002;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for allowing FDI in tea plantations;

153

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether Government are aware that
this step would open the floodgates for
multinational tea companies to enter the
Indian market in a big way adversely
affecting the Indian companies; and
(d) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
in this regard?
Survey on planned industrial
investments
*505.  SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there was a
huge drop in planned industrial investments
in new projects during the previous year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any survey has been
conducted in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) what are the reasons for this huge
drop?
Retail marketing of petro-products
*506. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are allowing private and foreign oil
companies to undertake retail marketing of
petrol/diesel and Aviation Turbine Fuel in
the country;
(b) if so, the reasons for allowing foreign
and private players in this sector; and
(c) in what manner the country is going
to be benefited by this step?
Restricted operations of airports in
A.P.
*507. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the airports in Andhra
Pradesh which operate between sunrise to
sunset only;
(b) what are the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government propose to
make all these or some of them operational
for 24 hours to increase air traffic in the
State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Production of crude oil
†*508. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that crude oil is
being produced by various companies in
the country;
(b) if so, the names of the companies
producing crude oil; and
(c) the quantity of crude oil produced by
these companies during 2001-2002,
company-wise?
New international airport at Bangalore
*509. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO:
SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a new international airport
project at Bangalore is being taken up;

154

(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the target for completion of the
project?
Preservation of Mullaperiyar dam
*510. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have appointed
any committee to study the safety of the
Mullaperiyar dam;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the committee heard the
views expressed by the State Government
of Kerala; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
preserve this hundred years old dam?
International crude oil prices
*511. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the April 30, 2002/Vaisakha 10, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance; Petroleum and

Total number of questions—155

Smuggling in IA flights
3636. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item which appeared
in the Asian Age dated the 24th March, 2002
stating that some of the domestic flights in
the Indian Airlines are being misused to
smuggle foreign consumer products to New
Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the corrective/preventive steps
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Security lapse at Coimbatore airport
3637. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM:Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of a
major security lapse at Coimbatore airport
within a week after the Central Industrial
Security Force took over;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any person has been held
responsible for such a great risk; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to stop
recurrence of such lapse at airports all over
the country?
Security lapses at international
airports
3638. SHRI C.O. POULOSE:Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
'International airport vulnerable to secruity
breach' which appeared in Hindustan Times
dated the 2nd February, 2002;
(b) if so, the number of incidents of
security lapses which occurred at
international airports in the country during
the last year;
(c) whether any action has been taken
against the officials for the security lapses;
(d) if so, the details in this regard; and
(e) the steps taken by Government in
order to prevent such security lapses?

793
WIN2\SESSION\437RS-QUES 793
Airports at Tuticorin and Salem in
Tamil Nadu
3639. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
long pending demand of airport terminals at
Tuticorin and Salem, important commercial
towns in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, whether any decision has been
taken to open airport terminals;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Commission to travel agents
3640. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Airlines, Air India and Alliance Air have
decided to cut commission to the travel
agents;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that tourism
industry has been hit very badly after terrorist
attacks in India recently; and
(d) if so, the reasons for not giving
adequate incentives to tourists and travel
related industry by offering more
commission to travel agents?
IGI Airport
3641. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item which appeared
in The Indian Express, New Delhi edition
dated the 9th April, 2002 about the New
Delhi international airport;
(b) if so, what is Government's reaction
to the observations made about the state of
affairs of the IGI Airport; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken, if
any, to improve the situation thereof?
Difficulties faced by passengers at
Chennai airport
3642. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item which appeared
in the Indian Express, New Delhi, dated the
12th April, 2002 captioned ‘At Chennai
Airport, your long jouney begins when you
land’;
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
Government's reaction to the observations
made about the state of affairs at the airport
and the difficulties being faced by the
passengers; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken, if
any, to improve the situation?
Traffic between India and UK
3643. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a speedy
recovery in the traffic between India and the
UK;
(b) if so, whether the British Airways is
planning to spread its wings to Bangalore
and Hyderabad and has decided to expand
capacity in the Indian market in a big way;
(c) if so, what are the UK based airline
connections at present;
(d) to what extent it will be more during
the current financial year; and

794
WIN2\SESSION\437RS-QUES 794
(e) whether the British Airways is also
considering to hike fares?
Findings of the air crash near Mainpuri

Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government had instituted
an inquiry into the air crash near Mainpuri
on September 30, 2001 involving Shri
